server.name: athena
server.title: Athena powered by ALP, construction agents

tools.name: change_order_log
tools.title: Change-order log and records
tools.description: Reads numbered potential and issued change orders, sourced pricing, decisions, execution and persistent package links. Separate from open items and RFIs.

tools.name: change_order_record
tools.title: Save a change-order package record
tools.description: Creates a numbered PCO, saves sourced pricing, records a confirmed owner decision or execution, and reopens an issued proposal as a new revision. Execution adds a separate fee-inclusive SOV line; it does not alter earlier billing or the CPM. Attachments, PDF builds and approved delivery use the shared submittal package tools.

tools.name: rfi_log
tools.title: RFI log and request records
tools.description: Reads the saved request-for-information log or one numbered RFI, with its question, references, status and persistent package links.

tools.name: rfi_record
tools.title: Save an RFI package record
tools.description: Creates or edits a numbered request package, captures a response, or explicitly closes/reopens it; attachments, PDF builds and approved delivery use the shared submittal package tools.

source_id.description: Optional ID of a drawing stored on this job; specification and contract references use their exact citation.
Optional ID of a drawing stored on this job; specification and contract references use their exact citation.

tools.name: rfc_log
tools.title: RFC bid clarification log
tools.description: Reads the saved bid-stage request-for-clarification log or one numbered RFC, separately from construction RFIs and open items.

tools.name: rfc_record
tools.title: Save an RFC bid clarification package
tools.description: Creates or edits a numbered request package, captures a response, or explicitly closes/reopens it; attachments, PDF builds and approved delivery use the shared submittal package tools.

source_id.description: Optional ID of a drawing stored on this job; specification and contract references use their exact citation.
Optional ID of a drawing stored on this job; specification and contract references use their exact citation.

tools.name: jobs_list
tools.title: List my jobs
tools.description: Lists every job the member can access across all their companies, grouped by company, or filters to an explicitly named company without changing their current company.

tools.name: drawing_sets_list
tools.title: List stored drawing sets
tools.description: Lists a job's stored drawing sets with source IDs, revisions and sheet names without importing, indexing, downloading or changing a drawing.

tools.name: onboarding
tools.title: Company profile and members
tools.description: Reads or saves the company profile and its members.

tools.name: intake
tools.title: Job setup intake
tools.description: Records a job and its setup, and for a draft, what-if or proposed SOV call this intake tool with the argument sov_copy set to "draft" (sov_copy is an intake argument, not a separate tool; never build one yourself) and say saved only after it returns "Saved in Athena".

tools.name: next_question
tools.title: Next question
tools.description: Returns the next setup question for a job.

tools.name: answer
tools.title: Answer or mark N/A
tools.description: Records the answer to the current setup question.

tools.name: report
tools.title: Job report
tools.description: Returns the job setup report or a two-week lookahead.

tools.name: contract_terms
tools.title: Read contract terms
tools.description: Reads exact automatically extracted contract/spec clauses with filename, source ID and physical PDF pages, plus saved contract value and completion date; continue clause results with source_offset when next_source_offset is provided.

tools.name: carry_forward
tools.title: Carry forward open items
tools.description: Moves open items from one lookahead into the next.

tools.name: list_open_items
tools.title: List open items
tools.description: Lists explicitly requested open items for a job_number the member just gave without filling job_number from chat context; for "open the project board" or "open the job board", use report_page_link with page "home" instead.

tools.name: lookahead_list
tools.title: List lookaheads
tools.description: Lists how many lookaheads a job has, which are visible, and writes nothing.

tools.name: lookahead_get
tools.title: Show saved lookahead and its items
tools.description: Reads a job's saved lookahead, its items and current schedule window. Returns the styled card and every saved item directly; no PDF, email or upload needed.

tools.name: resolve_item
tools.title: Resolve or update an open item
tools.description: Previews a selected open item and its evidence, and closes it only after the member's separate yes with confirmed and the matching confirmation_key; update leaves it open.

tools.name: cpm_activities
tools.title: Full CPM activity list
tools.description: Returns the saved CPM activities for a job.

tools.name: living_report_get
tools.title: Living report master copy
tools.description: Returns the saved living report for a job.

tools.name: living_report_save
tools.title: Save living report version (after approval)
tools.description: Saves a new version of a living report after approval.

tools.name: billing_evidence_read
tools.title: Read project billing records
tools.description: Reads source-recorded invoices, credits, retainage, receipts and allocations for a project; it does not infer billing from progress.

tools.name: billing_evidence_record
tools.title: Review or save billing evidence
tools.description: Reviews and, after explicit confirmation, records one invoice, credit, receipt, allocation or correction using the project billing ledger.

tools.name: billing_document_upload
tools.title: Upload a billing document
tools.description: Stores a PDF, DOCX, TXT, JPEG, PNG or macro-free XLSX financial original for a full-access project. Spreadsheet values are not extracted or imported; no invoice or payment is recorded by upload.

tools.name: billing_documents
tools.title: List billing originals
tools.description: Lists project financial originals and associations or reads verified text from an exact original for a member with full project access.

tools.name: billing_document_link
tools.title: Link an original to an existing billing record
tools.description: Reviews and, after confirmation, links a verified original to an existing invoice version or receipt without changing financial facts.

tools.name: purchase_orders_read
tools.title: Find project suppliers and purchase orders
tools.description: Reads project counterparties, purchase orders and terms versions for a job.

tools.name: purchase_order_terms_read
tools.title: Read project purchase-order terms
tools.description: Reads terms and limited project party and order identifiers for the owner or contracts role without the financial ledger.

tools.name: purchase_orders_record
tools.title: Review or save project party, terms or purchase order
tools.description: Reviews and after explicit confirmation saves a project party, terms version, company default or purchase order draft.

tools.name: file_share
tools.title: Share a file as a link
tools.description: Stores a file for a job and returns a download link.

tools.name: file_share_revoke
tools.title: Turn off a file link
tools.description: Turns off a file link and deletes the stored file.

tools.name: lookahead_pdf
tools.title: Lookahead as a PDF file (for email)
tools.description: Builds the job's two-week lookahead as a PDF and returns a download link.

tools.name: report_page_link
tools.title: Project home or report link
tools.description: Opens the project board, job board, project home, or job dashboard with page "home" by default; use page "items" only for explicit Open items requests, other named pages for their reports, and page "chat" to refuse owner or client chat access and offer a read-only client report instead.

tools.name: report_page_share
tools.title: Share a report page (expiring link)
tools.description: Creates only an expiring read-only report link after confirmation; use page chat to refuse chat access without creating a link.

tools.name: report_page_share_revoke
tools.title: Turn off a report share link
tools.description: Turns off a report page share link.

tools.name: file_upload
tools.title: Upload a contract, spec, or submittal file
tools.description: Uploads a PDF, DOCX, or TXT for ChatGPT, Claude, and Grok Bot: action begin returns a two-hour upload link (send the raw bytes to that link, or open it and choose the file) then action finish stores it, action from_url fetches the client's https file link, and action chunk accepts base64 pieces of at most 12000 characters in order before finish, saving a contract or spec on the job or attaching a submittal piece; action prepare_readable with document_id explicitly prepares complete reusable PDF text for an existing saved source without replacing or uploading its original; use project_documents for reads.

tools.name: project_documents
tools.title: Read saved project documents
tools.description: Lists saved contract/spec sources and reads or searches an exact document_id without reattachment; PDF reads reuse complete saved text tied to the original hash or verified original bytes; search scans 100 physical pages from page and continues at next_pdf_page until null; read returns up to 5 pages with next_text_offset continuation via text_offset; verify checks original bytes without changing records.

tools.name: team_list
tools.title: Team: people, roles and jobs
tools.description: Lists the company's people, roles, and seats.

tools.name: team_invite
tools.title: Invite a person to the team
tools.description: Invites a person to the company.

tools.name: team_update_member
tools.title: Change a person's role or job access
tools.description: Changes a person's role or job access.

tools.name: team_remove_member
tools.title: Remove a person from the team
tools.description: Removes a person from the company.

tools.name: team_add_seats
tools.title: Add seats
tools.description: Adds company seats at $49 per seat per month.

tools.name: set_current_company
tools.title: Set my current company
tools.description: Sets which company to use when the member belongs to more than one.

tools.name: drawing_set_import
tools.title: Store a drawing set
tools.description: Stores an attached drawing PDF once and returns its source_id, asks once for missing sheet names in PDF page order, and reads or indexes that stored source by source_id without re-uploading; a direct PDF upload card is available and Drive/Dropbox links are optional.

tools.name: drawing_markup
tools.title: Mark up a stored drawing
tools.description: Prepares the stored sheet image and findings for inspection, then saves supplied pins, lines and areas in a dated copy using normalized 0..1 coordinates from the original image top-left, requiring source_id or source_filename to save the exact set and otherwise returning a source-selection preview, with unlocated findings kept in the key rather than guessed.

tools.name: sheet_calibrate
tools.title: Calibrate a stored drawing
tools.description: Reads the stored sheet's scale evidence or saves a calibration for a named plan/detail from two points and a known distance. Requires explicit confirmation of that reference. Different detail scales have separate regions. Recalibration keeps history and makes affected measurements proposals for review.

tools.name: takeoff_geometry
tools.title: Measure and review a drawing takeoff
tools.description: Reconcile drawings, notes, specifications and contract using the returned project context and estimate_gap_analysis, distinguishing supported measurements, uncertain interpretations, missing scope and conflicts with citations and specific questions. Locates and measures takeoff lines on an exact stored drawing. List opens Athena's measurement viewer. Scope confirms a named complete plan or room boundary for a count line without saving a quantity; counts need no scale. Confirm that area before Propose. Scope with line_nos confirms the same complete named area for several count lines in one call; it never accepts quantities. Propose without observations returns a target tile and reference images for the connected AI to inspect, with a pass_id and cursor. Propose with no line_no (or with line_nos) is a sheet read: the one target tile is returned with every open line that may appear on it, and the connected AI returns sheet_observations with that cursor and one entry per listed line, empty findings where nothing is visible; each line keeps its own pass and checkpoint, and lines not ready are listed with the reason. The connected AI returns observations on that TARGET TILE using x/y 0–1000, confidence and visible evidence, then calls Propose with the same pass_id/cursor and observations. Athena verifies physical locations, scope, kind and topology, computes quantities and advances the checkpoint; reported confidence is retained for review and never used as a rejection threshold. Project context is supplied at cursor 0; later targets return a bound context reference. Use reload_context true in a prepare call without observations if the context is missing or needs refreshing. No server-side AI service is used. For a dense target, split_region true returns four smaller images of only that pending region. Submit all four distinct observations.parts with part 0 to 3 and local image x/y 0–1000; Athena maps them to the original target and advances only after all four are returned. Review objects crossing split boundaries for repeated instances; coordinates alone cannot distinguish two nearby objects from two views of one object. Earlier checkpoints are retained. Only the target image is counted; reference images are orientation only. Empty findings means the AI inspected this target and found no instances, never that a tile can be skipped. Save records estimator-located pins, runs or areas as a review proposal; quantities are computed from geometry. Accept requires the estimator's explicit approval of the displayed revision. Reject keeps its reason and history. Tile returns a legible 200-dpi region; crop inspects a source-backed location. History reads immutable revisions; revise compares a corresponding newer source without accepting it. Accept_all confirms only the exact displayed revision list. Export creates a private dated geometry-derived PDF; download reopens a saved version. Never use an unlocated typed quantity as a measured takeoff.

tools.name: estimate_intake
tools.title: Estimating intake
tools.description: Starts estimating, confirms role and scope, warns before reusing a saved takeoff, stores supplied drawings and prepares a cited drawing/specification/contract review through estimate_doc_review and estimate_gap_analysis.

tools.name: estimate_doc_review
tools.title: Estimating document review
tools.description: Saves the sheet index, revisions and spec-versus-drawing list for a job.

tools.name: estimate_takeoff_save
tools.title: Save a takeoff
tools.description: Saves takeoff lines with mode upsert, the default, or mode replace, and stores a drawing PDF when one is sent.

tools.name: estimate_takeoff_get
tools.title: Read a takeoff
tools.description: Returns the saved takeoff for a job and includes a stored drawing page when a sheet is named or a line names a markup.

tools.name: estimate_takeoff_export
tools.title: Export a takeoff
tools.description: Exports the saved takeoff as CSV or a workbook layout.

tools.name: estimate_gap_analysis
tools.title: Estimate gap analysis
tools.description: Reconciles the host AI's takeoff with drawings, notes, specifications, contract and agreed scope, saving cited findings and estimator questions that distinguish supported quantities from uncertain readings, missing requirements, conflicts and unavailable context without back-solving quantities or treating confidence as measured accuracy.

tools.name: estimate_bid_check
tools.title: Sub bid check
tools.description: Checks each in-scope sub bid line against the takeoff for a general contractor or a self-performer and lists out-of-scope callouts in their own section.

tools.name: estimate_item_mark
tools.title: Estimator mark
tools.description: Records the estimator mark on an existing takeoff line or gap and does not create a gap or change its number.

tools.name: estimate_build
tools.title: Estimate summary
tools.description: Builds the estimate summary from settled quantities and the contractor rates as a landscape PDF.

tools.name: estimate_status
tools.title: Estimate status
tools.description: Returns the open, settled and dropped counts for an estimate.

tools.name: estimate_pricing
tools.title: Pricing walkthrough
tools.description: Prices a job from the contractor's labor and material rates, and asks for those rates when none are saved.

tools.name: estimate_rate_sources
tools.title: Rate references
tools.description: Saves which rate references the contractor chooses to carry for a job.

tools.name: estimate_general_conditions
tools.title: General conditions
tools.description: Builds the general conditions adder from the contractor's figures.

tools.name: estimate_requirements
tools.title: Special requirements
tools.description: Lists every non-installation project requirement, not only the examples, and keeps it out of labor and material.

tools.name: estimate_bid_summary
tools.title: Bid summary
tools.description: Compounds overhead and profit and returns the bid total for a job.

tools.name: superintendent_view
tools.title: Superintendent field board
tools.description: Shows the explicitly requested superintendent field board, also called the field board, the super board, or the superintendent board, including the super's plan and what the crew is doing; generic "give me the job board" or "open the project board" requests use report_page_link with page "home" instead.

tools.name: field_board
tools.title: Field board
tools.description: Shows an explicitly requested field board, super board, superintendent board, super's plan, or what the crew is doing for a job; generic "give me the job board" or "open the project board" requests use report_page_link with page "home" instead.

tools.name: superintendent_activity
tools.title: Self-perform or sub on an activity
tools.description: Saves whether an activity is self-perform or a sub, and the crew size.

tools.name: daily_report_draft
tools.title: Assemble a daily report
tools.description: Assembles a daily report from a transcript or typed notes and lists what is still missing.

tools.name: daily_report_save
tools.title: Save a confirmed daily report
tools.description: Saves a daily report after the superintendent confirms it.

tools.name: daily_report_get
tools.title: Saved daily report
tools.description: Returns a saved daily report for a job and date.

tools.name: field_pay_app
tools.title: Pay app from daily progress
tools.description: Builds the next pay application from saved daily progress so it ties to the schedule of values.

tools.name: field_schedule_feed
tools.title: Schedule percent from dailies
tools.description: Returns activity percent complete from saved dailies for the schedule update.

tools.name: field_production_rates
tools.title: Production rates from dailies
tools.description: Returns production rates from confirmed daily hours and quantities.

tools.name: field_production_summary
tools.title: Production from saved daily reports
tools.description: Shows a period of reported quantities, person-hours and actual production rates from saved daily work. Defaults to the last seven days in the job time zone or standard default; use this_week for the calendar week or provide both dates for a period up to 31 days.

tools.name: progress_photo_save
tools.title: Save a progress photo
tools.description: Stores a progress photo after its date and place on site are confirmed.

tools.name: progress_photos
tools.title: Progress photo gallery or PDF
tools.description: Returns progress photos for a date range, item, or area.

tools.name: daily_reminder
tools.title: Daily report reminder
tools.description: Reads or sets when the in-chat daily reminder appears.

tools.name: daily_reminder_run
tools.title: Preview the in-chat daily reminder
tools.description: Previews the in-chat daily reminder without sending email.

tools.name: pm_meeting
tools.title: Run construction PM meeting (Athena)
tools.description: Runs the construction PM meeting in Athena as a styled card, the job meeting on the schedule rather than a calendar appointment, when someone says run my PM meeting or start the project meeting, through schedule progress, the locked lookahead, subs suppliers and crews, change orders, billing, and the IOR, using the only job when one exists, and must not fill job_number from chat context or build a generic meeting widget; records named confirmations such as subs and crews confirmed, no issues through note and returns the saved checks, with crew confirmation and lookahead lock as separate answers.

tools.name: athena_morning_hitlist
tools.title: Athena, good morning, Hey Athena, good morning, Good morning Athena, Morning Athena, Athina what's on my hitlist this morning, Athina, Athen, Atena
tools.description: Runs the per-job morning meeting when a job number was given, and with no job number returns the morning brief across every visible job, not email or calendar and not Gmail.

tools.name: pm_morning
tools.title: PM morning meeting
tools.description: Runs the construction PM morning meeting when someone says morning meeting, PM morning, or start the morning meeting, picks the only job or the most recent job instead of asking which job, and does not hand the request to email or a calendar.

tools.name: pm_evening
tools.title: Evening wrap-up
tools.description: Runs the construction project evening wrap-up for a job the member just named, through dailies, photos, risks, what happened, schedule disruptions, and the log, and must not fill job_number from chat context or hand the request to a calendar.

tools.name: athena_hello
tools.title: Athena hello
tools.description: Opens compact saved-job and next-action guidance for a simple hello, Hey Athena, Athina, Athen or Atena; also safely handles Hey Athena, let's get started if this greeting tool is selected instead of getting_started; never starts a morning brief or creates records, and explicit Good morning Athena or morning-brief requests use morning_brief.

tools.name: morning_brief
tools.title: Morning brief
tools.description: Builds the member's construction morning brief across every job in every company they belong to, grouped by company when there is more than one, when they say Athena, good morning, Good morning Athena, Morning Athena, Athina what's on my hitlist this morning, Athen good morning, Atena good morning, hitlist, morning briefing, what's on my plate today, overdue, or today's deadlines on my jobs, Athena leads, the card always keeps the heading From your inbox and calendar, and when Gmail and Calendar can be read the placeholder rows are replaced with emails that came in overnight, unanswered emails that need a reply, and today's meetings, and when they cannot the placeholder rows stay and no error text is written, then the job side follows with the schedule, notices, submittals due, overdue items, and what happened yesterday versus what is due today, the reply is the full styled HTML card every time they ask, including From your inbox and calendar, and nothing is sent, with job_number for a named-job brief or without it for the all-job portfolio brief; generic greetings and get-started requests use getting_started or athena_hello instead, even after the briefing time.

tools.name: morning_brief_settings
tools.title: Morning briefing time
tools.description: Reads or sets this member's morning briefing time and on or off switch, including when they say set my morning briefing to 6am, and shows the saved setting without sending anything.

tools.name: job_cost_submissions_read
tools.title: Read job cost records
tools.description: Reads cost records for full-access members, or only the assigned superintendent’s own field submissions. Receipts are retrieved separately.

tools.name: job_cost_submission_record
tools.title: Review or submit job cost metadata
tools.description: Reviews and submits a supplier bill or field expense. Assigned superintendents may submit their own field expense for their job. Receipts are attached separately. It does not move funds or post to accounting.

tools.name: job_cost_accounting_record
tools.title: Review a job cost accounting action
tools.description: Stages approval, accounting posting or recorded settlement evidence after explicit review; it never makes a payment. Accounting authority is disabled pending policy.

tools.name: job_cost_pm_payment_approval
tools.title: Review and approve payment for a job
tools.description: Shows only the job's share of supplier bills and reimbursements, and records a PM payment approval for the exact version and job allocation. It does not post accounting or pay anyone.

tools.name: job_cost_pm_payment_withdraw
tools.title: Withdraw a job payment approval
tools.description: Reviews and withdraws an active job-specific PM payment approval. Previously recorded payments are preserved and no bank reversal or refund occurs.

tools.name: job_cost_receipt
tools.title: Store or read a field expense receipt
tools.description: Stores or reads an original for an existing assigned superintendent's own field-expense submission, with a separate receipt access check. Accounting and owners can read linked receipts. It does not post or pay a cost.

tools.name: accounting_reconciliation
tools.title: Review project accounting exceptions
tools.description: Reviews recorded billing and AP exceptions from complete scoped snapshots and reports unavailable coverage. Does not repair records or move money.

tools.name: accounting_report
tools.title: Job accounting evidence and accountant export
tools.description: Reads a job ledger, dated billing versus receipts, retainage, current posted costs, unpaid balances where supported, separate PO commitments and current budget comparison. Opens a private report with accountant CSV download. Missing cost coverage stays unknown; not a complete P&L.

tools.name: email_draft
tools.title: Show an email draft for review
tools.description: Shows an email draft for review.

tools.name: email_confirm_send
tools.title: Confirm sending one reviewed email
tools.description: Confirms that one reviewed email may be sent.

tools.name: submittal_log
tools.title: Hey Athena, log a submittal
tools.description: Adds, updates, or resubmits a job submittal when someone says Hey Athena, log a submittal, or uses a misspelling such as submital, submittle, sumittal, or submittall.

tools.name: submittals_list
tools.title: Submittal log and overdue submittals
tools.description: Lists a job's saved submittal log, one row at a time with number, title, status, ball in court, due date, and overdue, for a job number such as 2701, and resolves that number when it exists on exactly one company even if another company is active.

tools.name: submittals_import
tools.title: Import or paste a submittal log
tools.description: Previews a CSV or pasted submittal log and writes it only after a separate yes.

tools.name: project_record_search
tools.title: Project record for disputes and claims
tools.description: Shows the job record with the schedule of values, open items, and overdue items, and shows the dispute and claim file only when the member asks for disputes or claims, resolving a unique job number such as 2701 across companies.

tools.name: submittal_chase
tools.title: Chase a missing or overdue submittal
tools.description: Saves one exact chase draft for a missing or overdue registered submittal and waits for approval before sending, or previews it without saving when preview_only is true.

tools.name: submittal_package
tools.title: Collect and build a submittal package
tools.description: Collects immutable files using piece IDs, P-numbers or new_piece kind/source_party metadata; get reads the current package and full history without building, build creates missing content or reuses the current package, and rebuild_from_package_id targets an explicit replacement safely across repeated calls.

tools.name: submittal_delivery
tools.title: Review and record a submittal email
tools.description: Saves an exact package or chase draft, waits for approval and records a successful email provider receipt separately before counting a send.

tools.name: submittal_void
tools.title: Void a submittal
tools.description: Marks a submittal Void after a separate yes, keeps the row, and records who, when, and the reason.

tools.name: getting_started
tools.title: Start or resume with Athena
tools.description: Opens onboarding for Hey Athena, let's get started, let's get started, how does Athena work, or help getting started, taking priority over a generic greeting or proactive morning brief; shows saved jobs or first-job guidance and explains current document and cost-code routes without creating records, starting meetings or importing data.
